about: Blasts and the TF2 knockback they give you. Self knockback: force = min(forceCapHU, damage * selfDamageScale * (82 / hullHeight) * forceScale), damage = lerp(baseDamage, baseDamage*edgeDamageFraction, distance/selfRadius). No damage is ever applied (unlimited mode).

columns.baseDamage: damage at the centre (used only to size the push)
columns.selfRadiusHU: blast radius that reaches the shooter
columns.edgeDamageFraction: damage fraction at the edge of the radius
columns.selfDamageScaleAirborne: self-damage multiplier when airborne, applied before the push is sized
columns.selfDamageScaleGrounded: self-damage multiplier when on the ground
columns.forceScaleAirborne: TF2 self push scale when airborne
columns.forceScaleGrounded: TF2 self push scale when on the ground
columns.downBiasHU: the blast is treated as this much lower, biasing the push upward
columns.airDetRadiusScale: radius scale for a projectile that never touched a surface (1 = none)
columns.airDetRampTime: seconds after arming for that scale to ramp back to 1
columns.propForceScale: push scale for loose objects (TF2's scale for others)
columns.propReferenceMassKg: objects heavier than this are pushed proportionally less
columns.sounds: assets rows; one is picked at random
columns.flash: effects row drawn at the blast

rows.source: TF2 SDK TF_ROCKET_RADIUS 146, TF_ROCKET_RADIUS_FOR_RJS 121, tf_damagescale_self_soldier 0.6, tf_damageforcescale_self_soldier_rj 10 / _badrj 5, DamageForce cap 1000, ApplyPushFromDamage 10 HU down bias; wiki 50% edge splash
